integrity: The arrangement, singularity census, projective stabilizer, group order profile, and line-orbit decomposition are recomputed exactly over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt3)\) by the accompanying verifier.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the projective stabilizer of the specific arrangement \(\mathcal O_{49}=\Lambda_{\{2\},4}(C_{12})\), not the abstract automorphism group of its intersection lattice.
The proof uses the standard regular-dodecagon realization over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt3)\), which is projectively equivalent to the construction in the source.
An older simplicial-arrangement catalogue or unindexed computation could encode the same projective symmetry group under different notation.
title: Full projective symmetry of the 49-line dodecagon arrangement
